newsitem.title: ROMANIA: SOCCER-STEAUA FORWARD ADRIAN ILIE TO MOVE TO TURKEY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-STEAUA FORWARD ADRIAN ILIE TO MOVE TO TURKEY.

text.p: Romanian champions Steaua Bucharest have signed a preliminary accord with Turkey's Galatasaray to transfer forward Adrian Ilie to the Istanbul club, Steaua president Cornel Otelea said on Monday.

Otelea said the one-year contract, enabling Ilie to move to Galatasaray on November 25, was worth up to $3 million. "The deal involves a friendly in Istanbul and a training session for Steaua in Turkey," he said.
Earlier this month Ilie declared his intention of joining international team mate Gheorghe Hagi, who moved from Spain's Barcelona to Galatasaray in July.
"I want to join Hagi in Turkey because I like him very much. He is my idol," Ilie, 22, said.
"Ilie will be paid about $800,000 a year", Otelea said.
